summary_1line: Hanuman brings Rama and Lakshmana to Sugriva, who forms a fire‑witnessed alliance with Rama, promising mutual help against Bali and in the search for Sita.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hanuman, now in his monkey form, carries Rama and Lakshmana on his shoulders as he leaps up the mountain toward Sugriva.
Rama and Sugriva clasp hands before a small sacred fire while Hanuman stands beside them after kindling the flames.
Sugriva spreads a flowering sala branch as a seat while he and Rama sit together in friendship, with Hanuman offering Lakshmana a sandalwood branch.
